market.question: Will the highest temperature in London be 16°C on May 4?

assessment.reasoning: London City Airport May 4 forecast high ~18C (64F). The 16C bucket [16,17) is two degrees below forecast; with typical forecast error ~1-3C, probability is moderate but not the modal bucket.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Cloud cover/showers could pull the high lower toward the 16C bucket.
